== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Missing data ===
* Two posted pairings (Jonas Hagen Nørregaard vs Hayes Hunter; Greg Shaw vs Casper Jørgensen) have YouTube streams, but the first-post scoreboard does not name their winners. Source: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86388 Schedule and Scoreboard], t=86388.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Team naming differs by source: the information thread ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86302 t=86302]) frames the sides as North America and Europe; the pairings post ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86377 t=86377]) lists United States and Europe; the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-02-outrider-cup-iv/ PC results page] lists Team USA and Team Europe; the live scoreboard (t=86388) counts Team North America versus Team Europe. The article uses Team USA (as in 2019 and the 2023 wrap title) and the published six-player rosters.
